summary: Generalization play A: same-weekday-last-year level anchor (tlag_364) on the champion (recipe6_calendar_l2_yoy). Direct recipe carries recent (winter, in-backtest) level into the window; the frozen yardstick is a SPRING window winter folds never contain. tlag_364 gives last-year's level per target day, leak-free (k>>horizon). Aim: generalize to spring, not just lower backtest error
evidence: screen +0.0072 mean (5/8), NO regress, leak-free — but the gain is ALL January holiday-echo; spring-facing folds (Feb15-Mar28) net -0.0017. Fixed 364d lag aligns Christmas YoY, misaligns movable Easter. Low expected value on the spring holdout; shot not recommended on this variant

summary: Play B: Easter-phase-corrected YoY anchor (recipe6_calendar_l2_yoye). tlag_yoy uses shift (Easter_this-Easter_last) within +/-21d of Easter, 364 elsewhere. Fixes the one thing plain-364 misaligns (lunar Easter; nth-weekday holidays already 364-aligned). Decisive test: spring-facing folds 6-7 (straddle Easter 2016) turn non-negative
evidence: CONFIRMED the spring fix: spring-facing folds net -0.0017 (plain-YoY) -> +0.0106 (Easter); mean +0.0080, median +0.0068 (cond4 PASS). Screen sign-test discards (5/8, sampling). Validated ingredient; re-test under year-round folds

summary: Play B core: 3-year training history at same row count (recipe6_calendar_l2_hist3y, TRAIN_ORIGIN_SPACING 7->28). Base trains on ~280d (never sees the forecast season); 28-day spacing keeps 40 origins but spans ~3yr incl. prior springs. Tested on the v9 year-round proxy
evidence: 3yr history = spring FALSE-POSITIVE: +0.006 aggregate (6/8) but spring folds -0.057 (2015 -0.070). Holdout is spring -> would regress it. Recipe already strongest on spring; recency>volume for a drifting peak

summary: Play B stack: Easter-phase YoY anchor + 3yr history (recipe6_calendar_l2_yoye_h3y). Combines the validated spring-level anchor (r133) with the longer history, on the v9 year-round proxy (2 real spring folds)
evidence: Easter anchor + 3yr history: same spring regression (-0.059); anchor cannot rescue the history damage. Discarded with H166
